states.notes: SST rate file ARR2026Q4AUG28.csv, boundary file ARB2026Q4SEP17.zip; 2149172 boundary records in force on 2026-10-01. Combined rate = sum of the SST rate-file rates for each jurisdiction code on the boundary record.

County rows are CDTFA's rate for the county's unincorporated area. Rates include state, local and district taxes as CDTFA lists them per city/county; district taxes that cover only part of a city or unincorporated area are not in this table (CDTFA address lookup).
Statewide rate; DRS: no local sales taxes in Connecticut. The page gives no effective date; effectiveDate is its "Last Reviewed or Updated" date.
No state or local sales tax (Division of Revenue). Delaware's gross receipts tax is imposed on the seller and is not a sales tax. effectiveDate = the page's last-modified date.

County rows = 6% state rate + the county's total discretionary sales surtax (DOR surtax table, "current as of" date). Florida has no city-level sales tax. Surtax applies only to the first $5,000 of a single sale of tangible personal property; per-surtax effective/expiration dates are on Form DR-15DSS.

SST rate file GAR2026Q4OCT01.csv, boundary file GAB2026Q4AUG20.zip; 1973864 boundary records in force on 2026-10-01. Combined rate = sum of the SST rate-file rates for each jurisdiction code on the boundary record.

General excise tax (not a sales tax): 4% state GET + county surcharge, per county. Maximum pass-on rate published for Honolulu: 4.7120% (applies where the 0.5% surcharge applies). Each row's effectiveDate is the start of its county's current surcharge period. Kalawao County is not listed by the Department and is not loaded.

Receipts general-merchandise rate (combined state + local) per IDOR location ID. Business-district (address over-ride) rates come from IDOR's addendum address file (https://tax.illinois.gov/content/dam/soi/en/web/tax/research/taxrates/documents/salestaxrates/ordmacha-current.txt): the location's general rate is the blank-address record; each other taxing district is a 'special' row (locationCode '<id> Rxx'). Metro East locations with different high/low rates: the low rate is the location row, the high rate (only for taxpayers liable for the Metro East district tax) is a 'special' row '<id> high'. Grocery/drug, auto and cannabis rates are not loaded.
